book_title: Building AI Agents with Claude: How to Build a Digital Workforce That Automates Grunt Work, Cuts Overhead, and Scales Your Business
core_promise: Provide a complete operational framework to design, deploy, and govern an autonomous digital workforce using Claude, replacing manual back-office tasks and scaling operations without ballooning payroll.
target_persona: Founders, operators, and technical managers carrying operational debt, high administrative overhead, and fragmented manual task handoffs.
narrative_threads: Transitioning from passive chatbot prompting to proactive deterministic agent loops
Treating agent workflows like industrial assembly lines (Inputs -> Context -> Verification -> Action)
Contrasting manual back-office overhead against resilient, low-cost API/MCP infrastructure
TCAV Protocol as proprietary operational framework
Digital Shop Floor thesis — Claude as deterministic processing station, not conversational assistant
Zero-Drift Prompt Spec and XML-zoned system directives
Circuit breakers, HITL thresholds, and regression testing as enterprise-grade differentiators
